title: WorkItem
description: Long-lived work owned by one tenant (docs/harness/work-items.md). Each round is an ordinary chat turn on the item's own thread with request id `<itemId>_r<seq>`. `stage` is derived from stored facts on every read and is absent once the item has ended. `rounds` and `inputs` are present on GET /v1/work-items/{id} only.

seq.description: Rounds started so far; the last round's seq.

subscriptions.description: Every source the item follows or followed, live or dropped. Present on GET /v1/work-items/{id} only.

outbox.description: The replies the item sent or will send, oldest first (work-items.md §8). Present on GET /v1/work-items/{id} only.

approvals.description: The approvals the item waited on, oldest first (work-items.md §7, slice 5). Present on GET /v1/work-items/{id} only.

mandate.description: Why the agent may do this work. Immutable once written.

policyHash.description: Empty until work rules exist; an empty hash never takes the revalidation fast path.

attention.description: The one thing a person must do for the work to go on (work-items.md §7), set only by a round. question: the report's structured question, cleared by the requester's next message or POST /v1/work-items/{id}/answer. approval: a pending approval a round's tool call gave up waiting on; `question` is what the approval asks, and its resolution through /v1/policy/approvals/{approvalId}/resolve clears it and wakes the item. `kind` is absent only in rows written before slice 5, and then means question.

reportAttention.description: The question a report asks, as the model wrote it.

approvalLink.description: An approval a round's tool call gave up waiting on, which the item waits on (work-items.md §7). The approval itself is in /v1/policy/approvals. pending: not resolved yet; approved: the item's next round may run that very call (same tool and arguments) once under it; rejected; gone: the policy engine no longer has it; used: a round ran the call under it.

roundSeq.description: The round whose call last waited on it.

question.description: What the approval asks: its reason.

report.description: A round's report as recorded. `reason` is set by the daemon, never by the model: report_unreadable when the reply did not conform to work-item-report.schema.json.

outcome.description: settled: the report status, or report_unreadable. failed: the chat error code of a turn that ended without a report, or interrupted (a restart ended the round and it was not rerun).

startedAt.description: When the round started, or when a boot last reran it.

subscription.description: A source the item follows (work-items.md §4, §5.2). An owner subscription lets the person who asked wake the item from that conversation; at most one live owner per conversation (D2). A dropped subscription is kept with when and why.

sourceKey.description: Matched by equality. For IM, the conversation's thr_src_ thread id.

outboxRow.description: A reply to a conversation (work-items.md §8). For one (item, conversationKey) a row is sent only once every earlier row is sent or dropped. queued: not tried yet; failed: tried and retried at nextAttemptAt (5 s doubling to 300 s), still unsent; sent and dropped are final. After 3 failures in a row the item shows person/delivery. The body is shown here as an input's is; events never carry it.

conversationKey.description: With the item, the order key. For IM, the conversation's thr_src_ thread id.

roundSeq.description: The round the reply reports, when it reports one.

lastError.description: A stable code for the last failure, never the transport's own text: send_failed, receive_check_failed, or the drop reason.

externalMessageId.description: The platform's id of the last part sent.
